Document 1010: CHP: Drunk driver slept while Tesla appeared to drive Hwy 101 on autopilot
When a pair of California Highway Patrol officers pulled alongside a car cruising down Highway 101 in Redwood City before dawn Friday, they reported a shocking sight: a man fast asleep behind the wheel.
据加州公路巡警（CHP）报告，周五黎明前，当两名加州公路巡警在红木城驾车驶向一辆沿101号高速公路行驶的汽车时，他们看到了令人震惊的一幕：一名男子正在驾驶座上熟睡。
The car was a Tesla, the man was a Los Altos planning commissioner, and the ensuing freeway stop turned into a complex, seven-minute operation in which the officers had to outsmart the vehicle’s autopilot system because the driver was unresponsive, according to the CHP.
The arrest of 45-year-old Alexander Samek on suspicion of drunken driving reignited questions about the uses, and potential abuses, of self-driving technology.
据CHP称，这辆车是一辆特斯拉，该男子是洛斯阿尔托斯的一名规划委员，随后的高速公路拦截行动演变成了一场复杂的、长达七分钟的行动。由于司机毫无反应，警官们不得不智取这辆车的自动驾驶系统。
Reached by phone Friday afternoon, Samek, a real estate developer who runs the Kor Group, said, “I can’t talk right now,” before hanging up.
Officers observed Samek’s gray Tesla Model S around 3:30 a.m. as it sped south at 70 mph on Highway 101 near Whipple Avenue, said Art Montiel, a CHP spokesman. When officers pulled up next to the car, they allegedly saw Samek asleep, but the car was moving straight, leading them to believe it was in autopilot mode.
45岁的亚历山大·萨梅克因涉嫌酒后驾驶被捕，这重新引发了人们对自动驾驶技术的用途及其潜在滥用的质疑。
The officers slowed the car down after running a traffic break, with an officer behind Samek turning on emergency lights before driving across all lanes of the highway, in an S-shaped path, to slow traffic down behind the Tesla, Montiel said.
He said another officer drove a patrol car directly in front of Samek before gradually slowing down, prompting the Tesla to slow down as well and eventually come to a stop in the middle of the highway, north of the Embarcadero exit in Palo Alto — about 7 miles from where the stop was initiated.
周五下午，《此报》通过电话联系到了萨梅克，这位经营Kor集团的房地产开发商在挂断电话前说：“我现在不方便说话。”
Authorities said the entire operation took about seven minutes.
Officers then walked up to the Tesla and “attempted to wake up Samek by knocking on the window and giving verbal commands,” Montiel said. “After Samek woke up and got out of the Tesla, he was placed in the back of the patrol car and taken off the freeway.”
加州公路巡警发言人阿特·蒙蒂尔表示，凌晨3点30分左右，警官发现萨梅克的灰色特斯拉Model S在惠普尔大道附近的101号高速公路上以70英里的时速向南飞驰。当警官将车开到这辆车旁边时，据称他们看到萨梅克正在睡觉，但汽车仍在直线行驶，这让他们相信车辆处于自动驾驶模式。
At a nearby gas station, Montiel said, Samek was given a field sobriety test before being arrested.
Tesla, whose autopilot technology assists in steering, changing lanes and parking, has seen its vehicles involved in several notable accidents in the last few years.领域
蒙蒂尔说，警官在实施交通拦截后让车减速，萨梅克身后的一名警官打开了紧急灯光，然后以S形路线穿过高速公路的所有车道，以减缓特斯拉后方的交通流量。
In 2016, a man was killed in Florida after the Model S he was driving collided with a tractor trailer while the Tesla was in autopilot mode. In January, a man was arrested on suspicion of driving under the influence on the Bay Bridge. He told officers he had been using his Tesla’s autopilot mode. Also this year, a man driving a Model X on Highway 101 in Mountain View was killed after his vehicle, which was in autopilot mode, struck a concrete divider.
The company declined to comment on Friday’s incident.
他说，另一名警官将巡逻车直接开到萨梅克的车前，然后逐渐减速，促使特斯拉也随之减速，并最终在帕洛阿尔托Embarcadero出口以北的高速公路中央停下——这里距离开始拦截的地点约7英里。
On its website, Tesla notes that its autopilot technology is not synonymous with self-driving cars or autonomous vehicles, and that drivers must keep their hands on the wheel at all times.
William Riggs, a professor of transportation, technology and engineering at the University of San Francisco, said most cars have some variation of autonomous features, and as the technology advances, people will feel more comfortable being distracted when driving.
当局称，整个行动耗时约七分钟。
“The software and technology is so good that humans are going to violate it,” Riggs said. “The future of autonomy really invites a lot of opportunities to disengage from the driving activity as we see more and more AI in control of vehicles.”
John Simpson, privacy and technology project director with Consumer Watchdog, saw Friday’s incident as further evidence of Tesla drivers being inappropriately led to believe the autopilot function is akin to fully autonomous driving.
蒙蒂尔说，警官随后走到特斯拉旁，“试图通过敲击窗户和发出语音指令叫醒萨梅克”。“萨梅克醒来并走出特斯拉后，被安置在巡逻车后座，并被带离了高速公路。”
In May, Simpson’s organization and the Center for Auto Safety asked the Federal Trade Commission to investigate “deceptive and unfair” practices in the advertising and marketing of the autopilot feature.
“They’ve really unconscionably led people to believe, I think, that the car is far more capable of self-driving than actually is the case. That’s a huge problem,” Simpson said. “In this case, it sounds as if it played out with some incredible work by the state police — the Highway Patrol — to get the car to stop. But it’s really amazing they were able to do that.”
蒙蒂尔说，在附近的一个加油站，萨梅克接受了现场清醒度测试，随后被捕。
Jim McPherson, a Bay Area attorney and industry analyst, said the autopilot feature is supposed to cut out if the driver doesn’t keep a hand on the wheel and exert “a minimal amount of torque.”
“But the length of the warning is variable. It could be a few seconds, it could be a minute or two,” McPherson said. “It’s really quite a miracle that this guy continued for 7 miles without autopilot cutting out.”
特斯拉的自动驾驶技术可辅助转向、变道和停车，但近年来其车辆已卷入数起引人注目的事故。
McPherson said he would expect the autopilot system to have alerted the driver to keep his hands on the wheel.
“Also, if he’s asleep, any more than a slight nudge of the wheel or touch of the pedal is going to cancel autopilot,” McPherson said. “So for it to get as far as it did, it’s a surprise to me.”
2016年，一名男子在佛罗里达州遇难，当时他驾驶的Model S在特斯拉处于自动驾驶模式时与一辆拖拉机拖车相撞。今年1月，一名男子因涉嫌在海湾大桥酒后驾驶被捕。他告诉警官他当时正在使用特斯拉的自动驾驶模式。同样在今年，一名男子在山景城的101号高速公路上驾驶Model X时遇难，当时他处于自动驾驶模式的车辆撞上了混凝土隔离带。

Document 1012: Police in the San Francisco Bay Area took an unusual approach to stop a Tesla operating on Autopilot as a drunk driver slept behind the wheel
Bryan Logan/Business Insider The Tesla Model S involved in the incident is not pictured here.
Bryan Logan/商业内幕 涉事的特斯拉Model S并未出现在图片中。
Police in the Northern California town of Redwood City arrested a man they found sleeping behind the wheel of his Tesla Model S as it drove down a highway early Friday morning.
The electric luxury sedan had been travelling south on Highway 101, going about 70 mph, California Highway Patrol Officer Art Montiel told Business Insider.

Document 3341: AI image training dataset found to include child sexual abuse imagery
A popular training dataset for AI image generation contained links to child abuse imagery, [Stanford’s Internet Observatory found](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/news/investigation-finds-ai-image-generation-models-trained-child-abuse), potentially allowing AI models to create harmful content.
斯坦福互联网观测站发现，一个用于AI图像生成的热门训练数据集包含指向儿童虐待图像的链接，这可能导致AI模型生成有害内容。
LAION-5B, a dataset used by Stable Diffusion creator Stability AI, included at least 1,679 illegal images scraped from social media posts and popular adult websites.领域
The researchers began combing through the LAION dataset in September 2023 to investigate how much, if any, child sexual abuse material (CSAM) was present. They looked through hashes or the image’s identifiers. These were sent to CSAM detection platforms like PhotoDNA and verified by the Canadian Centre for Child Protection.
LAION-5B是Stable Diffusion的创建者Stability AI使用的一个数据集，其中包含了至少1679张从社交媒体帖子和热门成人网站抓取的非法图像。
The dataset does not keep repositories of the images, according to the [LAION website](https://laion.ai/faq/). It indexes the internet and contains links to images and alt text that it scrapes. Google’s initial version of the Imagen text-to-image AI tool, released only for research, trained on a different variant of LAION’s datasets called LAION-400M, an older version of 5B. The company said subsequent iterations did not use LAION datasets. The Stanford report noted Imagen’s developers found 400M included “a wide range of inappropriate content including pornographic imagery, racist slurs, and harmful social stereotypes.”
LAION, the nonprofit that manages the dataset, [told _Bloomberg_](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-12-20/large-ai-dataset-has-over-1-000-child-abuse-images-researchers-find?sref=ExbtjcSG) it has a “zero-tolerance” policy for harmful content and would temporarily remove the datasets online. Stability AI told the publication that it has guidelines against the misuse of its platforms. The company said that while it trained its models with LAION-5B, it focused on a portion of the dataset and fine-tuned it for safety.
研究人员于2023年9月开始梳理LAION数据集，以调查其中是否存在儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）以及存在的数量。他们检查了哈希值或图像标识符。这些信息被发送到PhotoDNA等CSAM检测平台，并由加拿大儿童保护中心进行了核实。
Stanford’s researchers said the presence of CSAM does not necessarily influence the output of models trained on the dataset. Still, there’s always the possibility the model learned something from the images.
“The presence of repeated identical instances of CSAM is also problematic, particularly due to its reinforcement of images of specific victims,” the report said.
根据LAION网站的信息，该数据集并不保存图像存储库。它对互联网进行索引，并包含其抓取的图像链接和替代文本。谷歌最初发布的Imagen文本转图像AI工具仅用于研究，它是在LAION数据集的一个名为LAION-400M的不同变体上训练的，这是5B的旧版本。该公司表示，后续迭代版本未使用LAION数据集。斯坦福大学的报告指出，Imagen的开发者发现400M包含“范围广泛的不当内容，包括色情图像、种族歧视性侮辱和有害的社会刻板印象。”
The researchers acknowledged it would be difficult to fully remove the problematic content, especially from the AI models trained on it. They recommended that models trained on LAION-5B, such as Stable Diffusion 1.5, “should be deprecated and distribution ceased where feasible.” Google released a new version of Imagen but has not made public which dataset it trained on aside from not using LAION.
US attorneys general have [called on Congress](https://www.theverge.com/2023/9/5/23860412/ai-attorneys-general-50-states-congress-csam) to set up a committee to investigate the impact of AI on child exploitation and prohibit the creation of AI-generated CSAM.
管理该数据集的非营利组织LAION告诉《彭博社》，其对有害内容采取“零容忍”政策，并将暂时移除在线数据集。Stability AI告诉该媒体，其平台有防止滥用的准则。该公司表示，虽然它使用LAION-5B训练模型，但其重点关注了数据集的一部分，并对其进行了安全微调。
_**Correction, December 20 2:42 PM ET:** Updated to clarify Google’s first version of Imagen trained on LAION-400M and not LAION-5B, and includes more information on LAION-400M from the Stanford report. We regret the error._
Document 3349: A free AI image dataset, removed for child sex abuse images, has come under fire before
A massive open-source AI dataset, LAION-5B, which has been used to train popular AI text-to-image generators like Stable Diffusion 1.5 and Google's Imagen用途, contains at least 1,008 instances of child sexual abuse material, [a new report](https://purl.stanford.edu/kh752sm9123)[ from the Stanford Internet Observatory](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/news/investigation-finds-ai-image-generation-models-trained-child-abuse) found --- with thousands more instances suspected. The Stanford Internet Observatory is a program of the [Cyber Policy Center](https://cyber.fsi.stanford.edu/), a joint initiative of the [Freeman Spogli Institute for International Studies](http://fsi.stanford.edu/) and [Stanford Law School](https://law.stanford.edu/).
斯坦福互联网观测站的一份新报告发现，已被用于训练 Stable Diffusion 1.5 和谷歌 Imagen 等流行 AI 文生图生成器的海量开源 AI 数据集 LAION-5B，包含至少 1008 个儿童性虐待材料实例——另有数千个实例被怀疑存在。斯坦福互联网观测室是网络政策中心的一个项目，该中心是弗里曼·斯波利国际研究所和斯坦福法学院的联合倡议。
The LAION-5B dataset, which [was released](https://laion.ai/blog/laion-5b/) in March 2022 and contains more than 5 billion images and related captions from the internet, may also include thousands of additional pieces of suspected child sexual abuse material, or CSAM, according to the report. The report warned that CSAM material in the dataset could enable AI products built on this data to output new and potentially realistic child abuse content.
In response, [LAION told 404 Media on Tuesday](https://www.404media.co/laion-datasets-removed-stanford-csam-child-abuse/) that out of "an abundance of caution," it was taking down its datasets temporarily "to ensure they are safe before republishing them."
报告指出，于 2022 年 3 月发布、包含超过 50 亿张互联网图像及相关标题的 LAION-5B 数据集，可能还包含数千个额外的疑似儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）。报告警告称，数据集中存在的 CSAM 材料可能导致基于该数据构建的 AI 产品输出新的、且可能逼真的儿童虐待内容。
LAION datasets have come under fire before
------------------------------------------
作为回应，LAION 周二告诉 404 Media，出于“谨慎起见”，它正在暂时撤下其数据集，“以确保在重新发布之前它们是安全的。”
But this is not the first time LAION's image datasets has come under fire. As far back as October 2021, cognitive scientist Abeba Birhane, currently a senior fellow in trustworthy AI at Mozilla, [published](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.01963) a paper, *Multimodal datasets: misogyny, pornography, and malignant stereotypes*, which examined LAION-400M, an earlier image dataset. It found that the dataset contained "troublesome and explicit images and text pairs of rape, pornography, malign stereotypes, racist and ethnic slurs, and other extremely problematic content."
In September 2022, there was an instance of an [artist discovering private medical record photos](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2022/09/artist-finds-private-medical-record-photos-in-popular-ai-training-data-set/) taken by her doctor in 2013 referenced in the LAION-5B image dataset. The artist, Lapine, discovered the photos on the [Have I Been Trained](https://arstechnica.com/information-technology/2022/09/have-ai-image-generators-assimilated-your-art-new-tool-lets-you-check/) website, which allows people to look for their work in popular AI training datasets.
LAION 数据集此前曾遭受抨击
And a class-action lawsuit, *[Andersen et al. v. Stability AI LTD et al.](https://docs.justia.com/cases/federal/district-courts/california/candce/3:2023cv00201/407208/67)*, was brought by visual artists Sarah Andersen, Kelly McKernan, and Karla Ortiz against Stability AI, Midjourney, and DeviantArt in January 2023. While LAION was not sued, it was named in the lawsuit, which said that "Stability is alleged to have 'downloaded of otherwise acquired copies of billions of copyrighted images without permission to create Stable Diffusion' known as 'training images.' Over five billion images were scraped (and thereby copied) from the internet for training purposes for Stable Diffusion through the services of an organization (LAION, Large-Scale Artificial Intelligence Open Network) paid by Stability."
------------------------------------------
Ortiz, an award-winning artist who has worked for[ Industrial Light & Magic (ILM](http://www.ilm.com/)), [Marvel Film Studios](http://marvel.com/movies), [Universal Studios](http://www.darkuniverse.com/) and [HBO](https://variety.com/2018/tv/news/hbo-joss-whedon-the-nevers-1202872854/), [spoke at a virtual FTC panel](https://venturebeat.com/ai/our-lifes-work-chorus-of-creative-workers-demands-ai-regulation-at-ftc-roundtable/) in October and discussed the LAION-5B dataset.
"LAION-5B is a dataset that contains 5.8 billion text and image pairs, which...includes the entirety of my work and the work of almost everyone I know," she said. "Beyond intellectual property, data sets like LAION-5B also contain deeply concerning material like private medical records, non consensual pornography, images of children, even social media pictures of our actual faces."
但这并非 LAION 的图像数据集第一次遭受抨击。早在 2021 年 10 月，现任 Mozilla 可信 AI 高级研究员的认知科学家阿贝巴·比尔哈内发表了一篇题为《多模态数据集：厌女症、色情内容和恶性刻板印象》的论文，对早期的图像数据集 LAION-400M 进行了审查。研究发现，该数据集包含“令人不安且露骨的强奸、色情、恶性刻板印象、种族主义和种族侮辱以及其他极具问题的内容的图像和文本对。”
AI pioneer Andrew Ng has criticized removing access to LAION
------------------------------------------------------------
2022 年 9 月，曾发生一起事件，一位艺术家在 LAION-5B 图像数据集中发现了其医生于 2013 年拍摄的私人医疗记录照片。这位名叫 Lapine 的艺术家在“Have I Been Trained”网站上发现了这些照片，该网站允许人们在流行的 AI 训练数据集中搜索自己的作品。
As VentureBeat [reported in September](https://venturebeat.com/ai/potential-supreme-court-clash-looms-over-copyright-issues-in-generative-ai-training-data/), Andrew Ng, former co-founder and head of Google Brain, has made no bones about the fact that the latest advances in machine learning have depended on free access to large quantities of data, much of it scraped from the open internet.
In an issue of his DeepLearning.ai newsletter, The Batch, titled "[It's Time to Update Copyright for Generative AI](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/time-to-update-copyright-for-generative-ai/), he wrote that a lack of access to massive popular datasets such as  [Common Crawl](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQ33q3n5V1-WJV7CgPWpW4KfMvK2HqQXkW8FY-zt49PbszW4-jF1t7K4-4hW7ZmJzZ1DZpLBW7-bVjd19jz7RVvcM7z6hlK5-W75-Rn-5HfXlBW1B96zg3QLzKwVmzhN58nmfmZW90hRX57kwD1LW6dJtvS4LS99kW3z6zfX7gs9yTW8X6yYT2gvfg9W6wgX-81XPrpFW89vsRS8yhmZgW31YhYq1xxVblW8ZV4tY5Nx2mvW4jV-3t2m0qdTW2cf6bw7GR3SgN7X4ZyXT2vHZ3jgf1), [The Pile](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQm3q3npV1-WJV7CgPrlW5KbvhX4X5qK3Vk8gDG5wWNd2W776frg5hW8C-W14dHxx2-81xpW2tsvlW7M8PX2W3WbNcm955t-JW4zvv8m6QNP4yN92X7zyzfHSnVBKQBl6vyB6QW33ZKhL3Dg58bW2rwCjQ3ygL7HW35SqSl6KtFb2VWdCFs8MVW87W5w3y6x2gsD8MW3BtTlS4ZgTdQN886Q5xd5G9fVwGBf-5C0rDGW8KNnlK4WW_BrW4jWT3k8vZJx4W7vDQFY5H8NV7W4wDvcy9jwZGdW5WRFvg11HLbw3nlP1), and [LAION](https://info.deeplearning.ai/e3t/Ctc/LX+113/cJhC404/MVmLY3K1CLmW2S3Xqg2Hf-W4W72Qs8N519g86KqQm3q3npV1-WJV7CgLkWW34LtGc8lC301VR3Kbz1bKg_TW33wChm3hQnq2W2w_n1S4VY3QfW5T5xb_6DjlWzW5dlprX8GTrrsV3YNGB9cNSkpW4fmVJ578zKfxW69dMGd3LgstjW7jQynl97sYk7VNq9-582TmNtW2NtCck9dKcf6W3wq2-H56GkXWW3wyls26Y-W64W2FlD0F7dSNP1W7J8GWf6fkBZ3W6MJ90469lt52W3rPdpx8R-LcTMTrT6BxhP4KW5hVFdC1w8B81W59yY4G82b49LVVVfZF8WLjJv33Fl1) would put the brakes on progress or at least radically alter the economics of current research.
此外，视觉艺术家莎拉·安德森、凯利·麦克南和卡拉·奥尔蒂斯于 2023 年 1 月对 Stability AI、Midjourney 和 DeviantArt 提起了集体诉讼《安德森等人诉 Stability AI 有限公司等人案》。虽然 LAION 没有被起诉，但它在诉讼中被点名，诉讼称“据称 Stability‘在未经许可的情况下下载或以其他方式获取了数十亿张受版权保护的图像副本，以创建 Stable Diffusion’，即所谓的‘训练图像’。超过 50 亿张图像通过 Stability 付费的一家机构（LAION，大规模人工智能开放网络）的服务从互联网上被抓取（并因此被复制），用于 Stable Diffusion 的训练目的。”
"This would degrade AI's current and future benefits in areas such as art, education, drug development, and manufacturing, to name a few," he said.
And in the [June 7 edition](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/issue-200/) of The Batch, Ng admitted that the AI community is entering an era in which it will be called upon to be more transparent in our collection and use of data. "We shouldn't take resources like [LAION](https://laion.ai/) for granted, because we may not always have permission to use them," he wrote.
奥尔蒂斯是一位屡获殊荣的艺术家，曾为工业光魔（ILM）、漫威影业、环球影业和 HBO 工作，她于 10 月在联邦贸易委员会（FTC）的一次虚拟小组会议上发言，并讨论了 LAION-5B 数据集。
LAION was founded to create an open-source dataset
--------------------------------------------------
“LAION-5B 是一个包含 58 亿个文本和图像对的数据集，其中……包括我的全部作品以及我认识的几乎所有人的作品，”她说。“除了知识产权，像 LAION-5B 这样的数据集还包含令人深感担忧的材料，如私人医疗记录、非自愿色情内容、儿童图像，甚至是我们真实面孔的社交媒体图片。”
Hamburg, Germany-based high school teacher and trained actor Christoph Schuhmann helped found [LAION](https://rom1504.github.io/clip-retrieval/?back=https%3A%2F%2Fknn.laion.ai&index=laion5B-H-14&useMclip=false), short for "Large-scale AI Open Network. According to an [April 2023 Bloomberg article](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2023-04-24/a-high-school-teacher-s-free-image-database-powers-ai-unicorns), Schuhmann was hanging out on a Discord server for AI enthusiasts and was inspired by the first iteration of OpenAI's DALL-E to make sure there would be an open-source dataset to help train image-to-text diffusion models.
"Within a few weeks, Schuhmann and his colleagues had 3 million image-text pairs. After three months, they released a dataset with 400 million pairs," the Bloomberg article said. "That number is now over 5 billion, making LAION the largest free dataset of images and captions."
AI 先驱吴恩达批评限制访问 LAION
Since then, the [nonprofit LAION](https://laion.ai/) has weighed in publicly on open-source AI topics: For example, after an open letter in March 2023 calling for AI 'pause' [heated up a fierce debate](https://venturebeat.com/ai/open-letter-calling-for-ai-pause-shines-light-on-fierce-debate-around-risks-vs-hype/) around risks vs. hype, LAION [called for](https://www.heise.de/news/Open-source-AI-LAION-proposes-to-openly-replicate-GPT-4-a-public-call-8785603.html) accelerating research and establishing a joint, international computing cluster for large-scale open-source artificial intelligence models.
------------------------------------------------------------
LAION was scraped from visual data on shopping sites
----------------------------------------------------
据 VentureBeat 9 月报道，谷歌大脑前联合创始人兼负责人吴恩达毫不掩饰这样一个事实：机器学习的最新进展依赖于对大量数据的免费访问，其中大部分数据是从开放互联网上抓取的。
LAION was scraped, in part, by using visual data from online shopping services such as Shopify, eBay and Amazon. In a recent paper from the Allen Institute for AI called "[What's in My Big Data?](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2310.20707.pdf)", researchers studied LAION-2B-en, a subset of LAION-5B, which is 2.32 billion photo captions in English. It found, for example, that 6% of the documents in LAION-2B-en were from Shopify.
"That was a surprise because no one had looked at that before," Jesse Dodge, a research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI, told VentureBeat in November. "No one had been able to say like, what parts of the internet is the most images of text from in this dataset?"
在他名为 The Batch 的 DeepLearning.ai 时事通讯的一期题为《是时候为生成式 AI 更新版权法了》的文章中，他写道，如果无法访问 Common Crawl、The Pile 和 LAION 等海量流行数据集，将会阻碍进步，或者至少彻底改变当前研究的经济学。
Document 3354: Researchers found child abuse material in the largest AI image generation dataset
Researchers from the Stanford Internet Observatory say that a dataset used to train AI image generation tools contains at least 1,008 validated instances of child sexual abuse material. The Stanford researchers note that the presence of CSAM in the dataset could allow AI models that were trained on the data to generate new and even realistic instances of CSAM.
斯坦福互联网观测站的研究人员表示，一个用于训练AI图像生成工具的数据集包含至少1008个经核实的儿童性虐待材料（CSAM）实例。斯坦福研究人员指出，数据集中存在CSAM可能会让基于该数据训练的AI模型生成新的、甚至逼真的CSAM实例。
LAION, the non-profit that created the dataset, told [*404 Media*](https://www.404media.co/laion-datasets-removed-stanford-csam-child-abuse/) that it "has a zero tolerance policy for illegal content and in an abundance of caution, we are temporarily taking down the LAION datasets to ensure they are safe before republishing them." The organization added that, before publishing its datasets in the first place, it created filters to detect and remove illegal content from them. However, *404 *points out that LAION leaders have been aware since at least 2021 that there was a possibility of their systems picking up CSAM as they vacuumed up billions of images from the internet.
[According to previous reports](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/features/2023-04-24/a-high-school-teacher-s-free-image-database-powers-ai-unicorns?leadSource=uverify%20wall&sref=10lNAhZ9), the LAION-5B dataset in question contains "millions of images of pornography, violence, child nudity, racist memes, hate symbols, copyrighted art and works scraped from private company websites." Overall, it includes more than 5 billion images and associated descriptive captions (the dataset itself doesn't include any images but rather links to scraped images and alt text). LAION founder Christoph Schuhmann said earlier this year that while he was not aware of any CSAM in the dataset, he hadn't examined the data in great depth.
创建该数据集的非营利组织LAION告诉《404 Media》，该组织“对非法内容采取零容忍政策，出于高度谨慎，我们暂时下架LAION数据集，以确保其在重新发布前是安全的。”该组织补充说，在最初发布数据集之前，它创建了过滤器来检测并删除其中的非法内容。然而，《404 Media》指出，LAION的负责人早在2021年就已意识到，当他们的系统从互联网上抓取数十亿张图片时，存在获取CSAM的可能性。
It's illegal for most institutions in the US to view CSAM for verification purposes. As such, the Stanford researchers used several techniques to look for potential CSAM. According to [their paper](https://stacks.stanford.edu/file/druid:kh752sm9123/ml_training_data_csam_report-2023-12-20.pdf), they employed "perceptual hash‐based detection, cryptographic hash‐based detection, and nearest‐neighbors analysis leveraging the image embeddings in the dataset itself." They found 3,226 entries that contained suspected CSAM. Many of those images were confirmed as CSAM by third parties such as PhotoDNA and the Canadian Centre for Child Protection.
Stability AI founder Emad Mostaque trained [Stable Diffusion](https://www.engadget.com/tag/s生命周期table-diffusion/) using a subset of LAION-5B data. The first research version of Google's Imagen text-to-image model was [trained on](https://www.engadget.com/google-imagen-text-to-image-ai-unprecedented-photorealism-144205123.html) LAION-400M, but that was never released; Google says that none of the following iterations of Imagen use any LAION datasets. A Stability AI spokesperson told [*Bloomberg*](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-12-20/large-ai-dataset-has-over-1-000-child-abuse-images-researchers-find)that it prohibits the use of its test-to-image systems for illegal purposes, such as creating or editing CSAM."This report focuses on the LAION-5B dataset as a whole," the spokesperson said. "Stability AI models were trained on a filtered subset of that dataset. In addition, we fine-tuned these models to mitigate residual behaviors."
据此前报道，涉事的LAION-5B数据集包含“数百万张色情、暴力、儿童裸体、种族主义模因、仇恨符号、受版权保护的艺术作品以及从私营公司网站抓取的作品的图片”。总体而言，它包含超过50亿张图片及相关的描述性说明文字（该数据集本身不包含任何图片，而是链接到抓取的图片和替代文本）。LAION创始人克里斯托夫·舒曼今年早些时候表示，虽然他不知道数据集中有任何CSAM，但他并未深入检查这些数据。
Stable Diffusion 2 (a more recent version of Stability AI's image generation tool) was trained on data that substantially filtered out 'unsafe' materials from the dataset. That, *Bloomberg *notes, makes it more difficult for users to generate explicit images. However, it's claimed that Stable Diffusion 1.5, which is still available on the internet, does not have the same protections. "Models based on Stable Diffusion 1.5 that have not had safety measures applied to them should be deprecated and distribution ceased where feasible," the Stanford paper's authors wrote.
**Correction, 4:30PM ET:** This story originally stated that Google's Imagen tool used a subset of LAION-5B data. The story has been updated to note that Imagen used LAION-400M in its first research version, but hasn't used any LAION data since then. We apologize for the error.
在美国，大多数机构为了验证目的查看CSAM是违法的。因此，斯坦福研究人员使用多种技术来寻找潜在的CSAM。根据他们的论文，他们采用了“基于感知哈希的检测、基于加密哈希的检测，以及利用数据集本身图像嵌入的最近邻分析”。他们发现了3226条包含疑似CSAM的条目。其中许多图片被PhotoDNA和加拿大儿童保护中心等第三方确认为CSAM。

Document 5610: FaceApp forced to pull 'racist' filters that allow 'digital blackface'
FaceApp forced to pull 'racist' filters that allow 'digital blackface'
FaceApp被迫下架涉嫌“种族主义”的滤镜，该滤镜允许用户进行“数字黑脸”
AI-powered program allowed users to edit selfies to fit into ‘Caucasian, Asian, Indian or Black’ categories causing outrage and immediate U-turn
这款AI驱动的程序允许用户编辑自拍，将其归入“高加索人、亚洲人、印度人或黑人”类别，引发了愤怒和立即的政策反转。
Popular AI-powered selfie program FaceApp was forced to pull new filters that allowed users to modify their pictures to look like different races, just hours after it launched it.生命周期
The app, which initially became famous for its features that let users edit images to look older or younger, or add a smile, launched the new filters around midday on Wednesday. They allowed a user to edit their image to fit one of four categories: Caucasian, Asian, Indian or Black.
流行的AI自拍程序FaceApp在推出新滤镜仅数小时后，就被迫将其下架。这些新滤镜允许用户修改照片，使其看起来像不同的种族。
FaceApp's 'ethnicity filters' are a pretty terrible idea. Like, maybe one of the worst ideas. https://t.co/kV09pNpWRs
Users rapidly pointed out that the feature wasn’t particularly sensitively handled: technology site The Verge described it as “tantamount to a sort of digital blackface, ‘dressing up’ as different ethnicities”, while TechCruch said the app “seems to be getting a little too focused on races rather than faces”.
该应用最初因其让用户编辑图像以看起来更老或更年轻、或添加笑容的功能而闻名，于周三中午左右推出了这些新滤镜。它们允许用户编辑图像以适应四个类别之一：高加索人、亚洲人、印度人或黑人。
me and my three ethnically diverse half brothers unequivocally condemn the new faceapp filters pic.twitter.com/uMNfIrb73f

FaceApp的“种族滤镜”真是一个糟糕透顶的主意。可以说，这是最糟糕的主意之一。 https://t.co/kV09pNpWRs
“They don’t have any positive or negative connotations associated with them,” the company’s chief executive Yaroslav Goncharov said. “They are even represented by the same icon. In addition to that, the list of those filters is shuffled for every photo, so each user sees them in a different order.”
But by 5pm on the same day, FaceApp apparently agreed with the criticism, pulling the new filters from its app. They were unavailable to users a few hours later.
用户迅速指出该功能的处理方式并不特别敏感：科技网站The Verge将其描述为“等同于一种数字黑脸，即‘装扮’成不同的种族”，而TechCrunch表示该应用“似乎过于关注种族而非面孔”。

Document 412: ‘Human error’: Indian driverless metro train plows through depot wall (VIDEO)
A driverless train on the New Delhi Metro has crashed during test run, with a carriage plowing through a depot wall. An inquiry has been launched, with metro officials citing "human error" as the main cause of the incident.
新德里地铁一列无人驾驶列车在试运行期间发生事故，一节车厢撞穿了车库围墙。目前已展开调查，地铁官员称“人为失误”是事故的主要原因。
The new automatically-operated train was being tested on Delhi's Magenta Line on Tuesday. At some point its brakes became disengaged, and the train rolled and crashed into a station wall, local media reports. As a result, it plowed through the wall, "barely missing crashing to the ground," according to NDTV.
Delhi Metro's magenta line, to be inaugurated by @narendramodi crashes through wall on test run. @htTweetspic.twitter.com/1eHemQjOhG — PANKAJ PARASHAR (@PANKAJPARASHAR_) December 19, 2017
这列新型自动运行列车于周二在德里的洋红色线进行测试。据当地媒体报道，刹车在某个时刻松开，列车滑行并撞上车站墙壁。据NDTV报道，列车因此撞穿墙壁，“险些坠落到地面”。
There were no people on board, and no one was reported injured in the incident. However, two carriages of the train were badly damaged.
READ MORE: Driverless SUV smashes through shop entrance, knocks down child (VIDEO)
德里地铁洋红色线原定由 @narendramodi 主持通车仪式，却在试运行中撞穿墙壁。@htTweets pic.twitter.com/1eHemQjOhG — PANKAJ PARASHAR (@PANKAJPARASHAR_) 2017年12月19日
Metro officials have ordered an inquiry into the incident, and blamed it on "human error and negligence." In a statement, they said maintenance staff in charge of the train had failed to test the brake system. "While the train was moving up the ramp for washing, it rolled back and hit the adjacent boundary wall," the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation said.
A 'driverless' Delhi Metro train of soon to be opened Magenta Line crashes through wall of Kalindi Kunj depot during a trial run @TOIDelhipic.twitter.com/kKSlcntJpi — Sidhartha Roy (@SidharthaRoyTOI) December 19, 2017
车上无人，据报道事故中无人受伤。然而，列车的两节车厢受损严重。
A 'driverless' Delhi Metro train of soon to be opened Magenta Line crashes through wall of Kalindi Kunj depot during a trial run @TOIDelhipic.twitter.com/M6gcNRSj2i — Sidhartha Roy (@SidharthaRoyTOI) December 19, 2017
The part of the line with the new self-driving train is scheduled to launch in less than a week, with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi set to open it. Despite the incident, the launch will go ahead as planned, metro officials said.

Document 427: Driverless Delhi Metro's Magenta Line train rams into wall during trial
NEW DELHI: A driverless Delhi Metro train, running on the Magenta line, on Tuesday rammed into a wall at Kalindi Kunj depot when it rolled back on a ramp when being taken for washing."The person who took charge of the train from the maintenance staff also did not check brake and proceeded with the train up to the washing plant built on a ramp. While stopping at the ramp, since the brakes were not available, the train rolled back causing this incident," ANI quoted DMRC as saying.According to the norms, when a train enters a workshop or depot, its brakes are decommissioned, to ensure thorough and detailed check, reported PTI.Once the train is re-commissioned, the brakes are tested by the maintenance staff in the depot before the train leaves the shed. The train movement inside the workshop area is done manually and not by the signalling system.There were no passengers on board when the accident occurred.DMRC termed the incident "prima facie a case of human error and negligence," and ordered a high-level inquiry by a three-member committee.It promised "appropriate action" after the inquiry. The Delhi government has also sought a report from the DMRC.The 12.64 kilometre-long Magenta line, expected to be inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi on December 25, runs from Delhi's Kalkaji Mandir station to Noida's Botanical Garden.Trains on the Magenta line will be the first to be driverless in the history of the Delhi Metro. However, drivers will be present on the trains for some time.The new line will make it easier and faster for Noida residents to travel to south Delhi. The train will travel through nine stations - Kalkaji Mandir, Okhla NSIC, Sukhdev Vihar, Jamia Milia Islamia, Jasola Vihar, Shaheen Bagh, Kalindi Kunj, Okhla Bird Sanctuary and Botanical Garden.

Document 432: Delhi Metro accident today: Driverless Magenta line train crashes through wall; Read full statement
A Delhi Metro mishap has been reported on Tuesday. (ANI PHOTO)
周二据报道发生了一起德里地铁事故。（ANI 照片）
Delhi Metro accident today: On December 19, during the trial run of the Magenta line, one of the trains reportedly met with an accident as it tore through an iron grill at the Kalindi Kunj Metro depot. Prime Minister Narendra Modi was scheduled to visit on December 25 to inaugurate Delhi Metro’s new Magenta Line which connects Delhi Metro’s Blue line to Violet Line, from Botanical Garden to Kalindi Kunj. As of now, there are no reports of casualties. The Magenta Line came as a breather for many commuters as it will reduce the distance between Noida and South Delhi to a mere 19-minute ride. Explaining the incident, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation issued a press release stating the reason behind the mishap.
In its press release, DMRC has ordered a high-level enquiry into this incident. The enquiry will have a committee of three Executive Directors: Executive Director/ Rolling Stock (Project), Executive Director/ Rolling Stock (O&M), Executive Director/ Operations. The press release explains the entire incident.
德里地铁今日事故：12月19日，在洋红色线（Magenta line）试运行期间，据报道一列列车在卡林迪库恩杰（Kalindi Kunj）地铁车场撞穿铁栅栏时发生事故。总理纳伦德拉·莫迪原定于12月25日访问此地，为德里地铁新的洋红色线主持开通仪式，该线路连接德里地铁蓝线和紫罗兰线，从植物园站至卡林迪库恩杰站。目前尚无人员伤亡的报告。洋红色线让许多通勤者松了一口气，因为它将诺伊达（Noida）和南德里之间的路程缩短至仅需19分钟。针对此次事件，德里地铁公司（DMRC）发布新闻稿解释了事故原因。
READ the full text by DMRC on Delhi Metro accident today:
An incident occurred at 3.40 PM (1540hrs) at the Kalindi Kunj Metro depot today which is under commissioning. A trial train was moved from the workshop without testing the brake system as a result of which, while the train was moving up the ramp for washing, it rolled back and hit the adjacent boundary wall. No person was injured in the incident.
在其新闻稿中，德里地铁公司已下令对此次事件进行高级别调查。调查委员会将由三名执行董事组成，分别是：执行董事/车辆（项目）、执行董事/车辆（运营与维护）、执行董事/运营。新闻稿对整个事件进行了说明。
As per normal procedure prescribed, when a train enters the workshop, the brakes of the train are decommissioned so that the train and its systems including the brakes can be freely checked. As per procedure, once the train is again re-commissioned, the brakes should have been tested by the maintenance staff in the depot before the train left the shed. The train movement inside the workshop area is done manually and not by the signalling system.
Prima facie, it appears, this was not done and subsequently, the person who took charge of the train from the maintenance staff also did not check the brake and proceeded with the train up to the washing plant built on a ramp. While stopping at the ramp, since the brakes were not available, the train rolled back causing this incident.
阅读德里地铁公司关于今日德里地铁事故的全文：
MD, DMRC has ordered a high-level enquiry into this incident by a committee of three officers of the rank of Executive Directors consisting of Executive Director/ Rolling Stock (Project), Executive Director/ Rolling Stock (O&M), Executive Director/ Operations. Prima facie it appears, to be a case of human error and negligence and appropriate action will be taken after the enquiry.
Anuj Dayal (ED/ Corp Comm)
今天下午3点40分（15时40分），正在交付使用过程中的卡林迪库恩杰地铁车场发生了一起事故。一列试运行列车在未测试制动系统的情况下从车间驶出，结果当列车沿坡道上行进行清洗时，发生溜车并撞上了相邻的围墙。事故中无人员受伤。
Watch the video of the mishap at the Kalindi Kunj Metro Depot:
Delhi Metro Train crashed into the wall. It happened at Kalindi Kunj depo. PM Narendra Modi will inaugurate the Botanical Garden on the Kalkaji Mandir stretch (Magenta Line) on December 25. pic.twitter.com/vyozISos01 — Shadab Moizee (@shadabmoizee) December 19, 2017
按照规定的正常程序，当列车进入车间时，列车制动器会被停用，以便自由检查列车及其系统（包括制动器）。根据程序，一旦列车重新启用，在列车离开车库前，车场维护人员应已对制动器进行了测试。车间区域内的列车移动是人工操作，而非通过信号系统进行。
The Metro trains on the Magenta Line will connect nine stations from the Violet Line to Blue Line. The train will run from Kalkaji Mandir, Okhla NSIC, Sukhdev Vihar, Jamia Milia Islamia, Jasola Vihar, Shaheen Bagh, Kalindi Kunj, Okhla Bird Sanctuary and Botanical Garden. The Magenta Line is the first line on the Delhi Metro have no drivers. However, drivers will be present on the trains for some time.用途

Document 196: California fires: Navigation apps like Waze sent commuters into flames, drivers say
Users of popular navigation apps like Waze are warning the services directed them to neighborhoods where wildfires forced closures and evacuations.
像Waze这样的热门导航应用用户警告称，这些服务将他们导向了因野火而被迫封闭和疏散的街区。
The issue stems from the way apps like Waze help users avoid commute nightmares such as heavy traffic or construction. Largely reliant on information supplied by other drivers, when the Google-owned app notices gridlock on a user's route, it will reroute the driver to quieter streets — even they're empty because drivers had fled smoke and the threat of flames用途
Waze, which also works with transportation authorities and a team of local map editors to keep the app updated, says on any given day, those enflamed neighborhoods would have been shown as off limits within an hour of two. "We worked really hard Wednesday afternoon to get our maps up to date and accurate," says Waze spokesperson Chelsea Russo.
这一问题源于Waze等应用帮助用户避开通勤噩梦（如严重交通拥堵或道路施工）的方式。由于主要依赖其他驾驶员提供的信息，当这款归谷歌所有的应用发现用户路线上出现交通瘫痪时，它会将驾驶员重新导向较为安静的街道——即使这些街道空无一人是因为驾驶员们已逃离了烟雾和火焰的威胁。

Whether because the Santa Ana wind-fueled fires were spreading too fast — or some other reason — drivers Wednesday morning said the app's lag led to directions onto side-streets where fires had already closed them to traffic.

变幻莫测的风让加州文图拉县的消防员备受困扰
The app suggested backstreets of the mansion-blanketed L.A. neighborhood of Bel Air instead, turning onto Bellagio Road, a thoroughfare that runs into the heart of Bel Air. Not noted by Waze at the time, there was a cop standing at the intersection, stopping drivers from passing through the Bel Air gates because the road led to the belly of the Skirball fire.

But sometimes routes go awry.
The Los Angeles Police Department was alerting users of navigation apps to avoid using them so they don't end up near the blazes, reported "The Los Angeles Times." Waze's Russo said the LAPD was working off Wednesday morning information.
无论是因为圣塔安娜风助长的火势蔓延太快，还是出于其他原因，周三上午，驾驶员们表示，应用的滞后导致他们被导向了因火灾已封闭的侧面街道。
An LAPD spokesperson didn't return a immediately return a request for comment.

Document 204: Waze, Google Maps make traffic matters worse during Skirball and Creek fires, officials say
LOS ANGELES During this week’s wildfires, navigation apps like Waze and Google Maps were guiding drivers into evacuation areas and caused congestion where officials were ordering streets closed生命周期, according to a motion introduced by Los Angeles City Councilman Paul Koretz on Friday, Dec. 8.
洛杉矶 据洛杉矶市议员保罗·科雷茨于12月8日星期五提出的一项动议称，在本周的野火期间，Waze和谷歌地图等导航应用程序将司机引导至疏散区域，并在官方下令封闭街道的地方造成了拥堵。
The Creek and Skirball fires caused large-scale evacuations of streets and neighborhoods, and the motion says that navigation apps were directing
drivers to those areas because the data indicated there was no traffic there.
克里克大火和斯基尔博尔大火导致街道和社区大规模疏散，动议指出，导航应用程序之所以将司机引导至这些区域，是因为数据显示那里没有交通拥堵。
“Cut-through traffic directed by Waze and other navigation apps has long created problems in many residential neighborhoods. But on the day of the
Skirball fire evacuation, drivers’ phones were navigating them into the fire zone, onto streets they weren’t familiar with,” Koretz told City News Service.
“由Waze和其他导航应用程序引导的抄近道交通长期以来在许多居民区制造了问题。但在斯基尔博尔大火疏散当天，司机的手机却将他们导航至火灾区域，引向了他们不熟悉的街道，”科雷茨告诉城市新闻社。
“Not only did it steer them into life-threatening danger, but it caused congestion where public safety officials were ordering streets cleared so residents under evacuation orders could safely get out and we could get our fire equipment in. With a simple change in the program code this could be avoided in the future,” he said.
The motion would direct the fire department and Department of Transportation to report on efforts to coordinate with navigation app developers to prevent their apps from directing drivers into evacuated areas.
“这不仅将他们引入了危及生命的险境，还在公共安全官员下令清空街道的区域造成了拥堵，其本意是为了让接到疏散令的居民能够安全撤离，并让我们的消防设备得以进入。只需对程序代码进行简单的修改，未来就可以避免这种情况，”他说。

Document 1973: Two rival self-driving cars have close call in California
MOUNTAIN VIEW, Calif. (Reuters) - Two self-driving prototype cars, one operated by Google Inc and the other by Delphi Automotive Plc, had a close call on a Silicon Valley street earlier this week, a Delphi executive told Reuters on Thursday.
加州山景城（路透社）——德尔福汽车公司的一位高管周四向路透社透露，本周早些时候，一辆由谷歌公司运营的自动驾驶原型车与一辆由德尔福汽车公司运营的自动驾驶原型车，在硅谷的一条街道上发生了一次险些相撞的“近距离接触”。
It was believed to be the first such incident involving two vehicles specially equipped for automated driving.
The incident occurred Tuesday on San Antonio Road in Palo Alto, said John Absmeier, director of Delphi’s Silicon Valley lab and global business director for the company’s automated driving program, who was a passenger in one of the cars.
据信，这是首次涉及两辆专门配备自动驾驶功能的车辆的事故。
No collision took place.
Google declined to comment.
德尔福硅谷实验室主任兼公司自动驾驶项目全球业务总监约翰·阿布施迈尔表示，事故发生在周二，地点位于帕洛阿尔托的圣安东尼奥路，当时他正乘坐其中一辆车。
Absmeier was a passenger in a prototype Audi Q5 crossover vehicle equipped with lasers, radar, cameras and special computer software designed to enable the vehicle to drive itself用途, with a person at the wheel as a backup.
As the Delphi vehicle prepared to change lanes, a Google self-driving prototype - a Lexus RX400h crossover fitted with similar hardware and software - cut off the Audi, forcing it to abort the lane change, Absmeier said.
两车并未发生碰撞。
The Delphi car “took appropriate action,” according to Absmeier.
Delphi’s Silicon Valley lab is based in Mountain View, not far from Google headquarters. While Delphi is running two Audi prototypes in California, Google has been testing more than 20 Lexus prototypes.
谷歌对此拒绝置评。
On Thursday, Google started testing self-driving vehicle prototypes of its own design on local streets. The latest prototypes use the same software as the Lexus vehicles.
Both companies previously have reported minor collisions of self-driving cars with vehicles piloted by people. In most of those cases, the self-driving car was stopped, typically at an intersection, and was rear-ended by another vehicle.
阿布施迈尔当时乘坐的是一辆原型奥迪Q5跨界车，该车配备了激光、雷达、摄像头和旨在实现自动驾驶的专用计算机软件，车上仍有一人作为备份驾驶员。
In all cases, the self-driving prototype was not at fault, according to the California Department of Motor Vehicles and the companies.
Document 269: Self-driving cars from rivals Google, Delphi in close call
There are few drivers who haven't experienced what it's like to be cut off by another motorist who nearly causes an accident. Now, two autonomous-driving cars from competing companies have matched that common human experience.
很少有司机没体验过被另一辆几乎引发事故的汽车强行超车的感觉。如今，来自两家竞争公司的自动驾驶汽车也遭遇了这种常见的人类经历。
Of course, the self-driving cars weren't able to give each other the finger after it happened.
Auto parts maker Delphi says that its experimental self-driving car was on a street in Silicon Valley earlier this week领域 and was moving into another lane when an experimental self-driving car from Google cut it off by moving into the same lane.
当然，事发后这两辆自动驾驶汽车没法向对方竖中指。
Delphi disclosed the incident to a Reuters reporter earlier this week and confirmed it to CNNMoney Friday. Spokeswoman Kristen Kinley insists it wasn't truly a near miss but was instead an example about how self-driving cars effectively avoid accidents.
"Our car saw the Google car move into the same lane as our car was planning to move into, but upon detecting that the lane was no longer open it decided to terminate the move and wait until it was clear again," she said.
汽车零部件制造商德尔福（Delphi）表示，本周早些时候，其自动驾驶实验车在硅谷的一条街道上行驶，正当它准备变道时，谷歌（Google）的一辆自动驾驶实验车也驶入了同一车道，将其截住。
Google agreed with Delphi's take on the incident.
"The headline here is that two self-driving cars did what they were supposed to do in a fairly ordinary everyday driving scenario," said a spokeswoman.
德尔福本周早些时候向路透社记者透露了这一事件，并于周五向CNNMoney证实了此事。发言人克里斯汀·金利坚称，这并非真正的险些相撞，而是自动驾驶汽车如何有效避免事故的一个范例。
Related Google's new self-driving cars hit the road
Self-driving cars are allowed on streets and highways in California, but they are required to have a human driver sitting behind the steering wheel able to take over control of the car if there is a problem. The cars are not yet for sale to the public. The self-driving vehicles now on the roads are being used by companies that are developing the technology.
她说：“我们的车发现谷歌的车驶入了我们计划进入的车道，但在检测到该车道不再空闲后，它决定终止变道并等待车道再次畅通。”
Self-driving cars are still rare, they're becoming more common on the streets near Google's Mountain View, Calif, headquarters. Google has 23 self-driving Lexus RX450h crossovers on the road, and recently put nine prototypes of its own self-driving car design on the road as well. Delphi, which recently drove a self-driving Audi across country, does most of its test drives near its autonomous driving lab, which is near to Google's headquarters.
Self-driving cars have been involved in a number of minor accidents with traditional driver cars during the last few years that they were being tested on the road. Google has driven the cars more than 1 million miles in autonomous driving mode. It says it has had 12 accidents. Most occurred when the autonomous driving car was stopped or nearly stopped and were struck from behind by a car with a driver.
谷歌认同德尔福对这一事件的看法。
There was a human driver sitting behind the wheel in all the cases, and in instances where the car was in motion when the accident occurred, the human driver took control of the car.
Document 274: Delphi Changes Story, Says Google Self-Driving Car Did Not Nearly Crash Into Audi
June 29, 2015
2015年6月29日
Delphi is back-pedaling after one of its executives told Reuters last week one of its self-driving vehicles had to take evasive maneuvers to avoid being side-swiped by an autonomous Google car.
Although Delphi executive John Absmeier — who was in the self-driving Audi (run by Delphi software) at the time of the incident — originally told Reuters the Delphi car “took appropriate action” to avoid being hit by a Google-operated self-driving Lexus, the company is now saying “the vehicles didn’t even come close to each other.”
继其一位高管上周告诉路透社，称其一辆自动驾驶汽车不得不采取规避动作以避免被一辆谷歌自动驾驶汽车侧面剐蹭后，德尔福（Delphi）正在撤回这一说法。
“During a recent visit with Reuters, our Delphi expert described an actual interaction that we encounter all the time in real-world driving situations. In this case, it was a typical lane change maneuver. No vehicle was cut off and the vehicles didn’t even come close to each other,” the Delphi spokeswoman told Reuters. “Both automated vehicles did exactly what they were supposed to do.”
Originally, Absmeier claimed the incident took place when the Delphi vehicle he was riding in was about to make a lane change but was cut off by the Google vehicle, forcing the Audio to abandon the lane change.
尽管德尔福高管约翰·阿布施迈尔（John Absmeier）——事发时正身处那辆由德尔福软件控制的自动驾驶奥迪车内——最初告诉路透社，德尔福的汽车“采取了适当行动”以避免被一辆谷歌运营的自动驾驶雷克萨斯撞到，但该公司现在却表示，“两辆车之间甚至离得很远。”
Although Google did not comment after Absmeier first talked to Reuters, it later released a short statement: “two self-driving cars did what they were supposed to do in an ordinary everyday driving scenario.”
Both Google and Delphi have labs based in Mountain View. Although Delphi is testing only two Audi prototypes, Google has had more than 20 Lexus vehicles equipped with its technology on California roads.
德尔福女发言人对路透社表示：“在最近接待路透社采访时，我们的德尔福专家描述了我们在现实驾驶情境中经常遇到的一种实际互动。在这个案例中，这是一次典型的变道操作。没有车辆被强行超车，两车之间甚至离得很远。两辆自动驾驶车辆都准确地执行了它们应该执行的操作。”
Google last Thursday began testing its own self-driving prototypes on California streets.生命周期 The Google-built vehicles use the same software and sensors as the Lexus prototypes.
Although both companies have reported accidents in the past, they were all no-fault incidents, mostly due to being rear-ended at traffic lights by another driver.
最初，阿布施迈尔声称事件发生时，他乘坐的德尔福车辆正准备变道，但被谷歌车辆强行切入，迫使这辆奥迪放弃了变道。
Jennifer Cowan is the Managing Editor for SiteProNews.

Document 363: Navinder Sarao: The man accused of causing the US market to crash
Image copyright Getty Images Image caption Navinder Sarao, the so-called "flash crash" day trader has been fighting attempts to extradite him to the US
图片版权 Getty Images 图片说明 纳温德·萨劳，这位所谓的“闪崩”日内交易者一直在抗争美国引渡他的企图。
Navinder Sarao, who traded from his parents' home in Hounslow, west London, has been accused of market manipulation that caused a 1,000-point fall on the US Dow Jones index in 2010.
He faces 22 charges in the US, including fraud charges, all of which he denies - which include "spoofing" - the practice of buying or selling with the intent to cancel the transaction before execution.
纳温德·萨劳在他父母位于伦敦西部豪恩斯洛的家中进行交易，他被指控操纵市场，导致2010年美国道琼斯指数暴跌1000点。
Set aside for a moment Navinder Sarao's guilt or innocence. What he did was astonishing.
From a computer in the bedroom he'd grown up in, at his parents' semi-detached house under the Heathrow flight path, this casually dressed 37-year old traded remotely on an exchange in Chicago he had never visited.
他在美国面临22项指控，包括欺诈指控，他否认了所有指控——其中包括“幌骗”（spoofing），即在进行买卖时意图在交易执行前取消交易。
In less than five years he made more than £30m.
Computerised trading
暂且不论纳温德·萨劳是否有罪。他的所作所为令人震惊。
Pause for thought. He was operating on the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, a highly computerised market where normal human beings stand little chance.
Computers operating so-called high frequency trading programmes pick up any sign of prices moving up or down - and jump in ahead of normal, slow-motion human traders.
在他父母位于希思罗机场航道下的半独立式住宅里，在他从小长大的卧室的一台电脑前，这位穿着随意的37岁男子远程在他从未去过的芝加哥交易所进行交易。
Image copyright Getty Images Image caption Computers will always beat humans when it comes to trading
You, the human trader, may see an order to buy pop up on your screen half a second after it's published on the exchange. It may be big enough to move the market up - so you could make money if you could buy quickly.
在不到五年的时间里，他赚了超过3000万英镑。
But because you're up against computers, by the time you click 'buy' it's already too late. Your brain took half a second to process the visual information - whereas a computer picked it up in a few milliseconds.
The high frequency traders bought, the price rose - and you lost your chance to make money.
计算机化交易
In Chicago, the pressure is fierce to see buy and sell orders just a few milliseconds ahead of the other guy.
Millisecond advantage
停下来想一想。他在芝加哥商品交易所运作，这是一个高度计算机化的市场，普通人类几乎没有机会。
As outlined in Michael Lewis's brilliant expose Flash Boys, a few milliseconds' head-start is worth so much money that the most determined traders buy expensive property close to the exchange and spend large sums installing super-fast cables - so the signal arrives just a few milliseconds faster.
Why? Because if your computerised trader gets the information two or three milliseconds before others, you can make money.
运行所谓高频交易程序的计算机捕捉到价格上涨或下跌的任何迹象——并抢在普通、动作缓慢的人类交易员之前介入。
Image copyright Getty Images Image caption But computerised trading does have a weakness, especially if the computers are programmed to react in similar ways
If it's a big buy order your computerised trader can buy ahead of others, "riding the trend" and adding to upward pressure on prices.
图片版权 Getty Images 图片说明 在交易方面，计算机将永远击败人类
The others who get the information a flash later can't "get in at the ground floor". Instead they buy after prices have already risen. And they're buying at those inflated prices from you - as you sell out for a quick buck.
'Spoofing' the computers
作为人类交易员，你可能看到一个买单在交易所发布半秒后才弹现在你的屏幕上。这个订单可能大到足以推高市场——所以如果你能快速买入，你就能赚钱。
What Navinder Sarao seems to have worked out, like others before him, was that the high frequency trading made the market twitchy.
Because many of the high frequency traders were programmed with similar software - designed, for example, to spot a large volume of buy orders and then ride the trend - they would all do more or less the same thing.
但因为你的对手是计算机，当你点击“买入”时，已经太晚了。你的大脑花了半秒钟处理视觉信息——而计算机在几毫秒内就捕捉到了。
Like a pack of sheep sent one way or another by a sheepdog, they could be spooked.
Or rather, "spoofed". According to the FBI's investigators, Nav Sarao had modified a commercially available piece of software - a trading algorithm, to do just that.用途
高频交易员买入，价格上涨——而你失去了赚钱的机会。
Image copyright Getty Images Image caption The FBI didn't only accuse Mr Sarao of placing fake orders to manipulate the market, it also accused him of helping to cause the flash crash
Using that software and at high speed, they alleged, he was placing big sell orders, sometimes amounting to hundreds of millions of dollars a day - trades with which he never intended to go through.
在芝加哥，为了比对手早几毫秒看到买卖订单，竞争压力异常激烈。
Instead they were designed to make the rest of the market (the computerised traders) believe the sell orders outweighed the buy orders, indicating the market was about to head down.
Sheep-like, the computerised traders would sell in order to avoid losing too much money as prices dropped. The weight of selling would push prices down.
毫秒优势
Meanwhile (according to the FBI) Mr Sarao would have placed a real buy order waiting for the market to drop. He would then buy at the lower price and cancel the sell orders.
When the market realised the sell orders had gone away, prices would bounce back. And Mr Sarao could then sell at that higher price and bank a profit.
正如迈克尔·刘易斯精彩的揭露性著作《高频交易员》中所述，几毫秒的先机价值连城，最坚定的交易员会在靠近交易所的地方购买昂贵的房产，并斥巨资安装超高速光缆——以便信号能早几毫秒到达。
That profit might be tiny. But if this operation were repeated hundreds of times per hour, the profits could be handsome.
Crucially, according to the FBI, those orders were fake, designed to "spoof" the market. Sarao didn't intend to go through with them. And that spoofing is an offence under US law.
为什么？因为如果你的计算机化交易员比别人早两三毫秒获得信息，你就能赚钱。
The FBI didn't only accuse Sarao of placing fake buy and sell orders to manipulate the market. It also accused him of
Document 365: How an Indian-origin trader caused the 2010 ‘flash crash’
An Indian-origin futures trader has been arrested in the U.K. and faces extradition to the U.S. for his alleged role in the May 2010 “flash crash” which wiped billions of dollars off the value of U.S. shares in minutes.
一名印度裔期货交易员在英国被捕，并因涉嫌参与2010年5月的“闪电崩盘”事件面临引渡至美国，该事件在几分钟内导致美国股票市值蒸发数十亿美元。
Navinder Singh Sarao (37) was arrested by British authorities yesterday at the request of the U.S. Department of Justice and the U.S. is requesting his extradition.
Mr. Sarao was charged in a federal criminal complaint in the Northern District of Illinois in February 2015.
纳温德·辛格·萨拉奥（37岁）昨日应美国司法部请求被英国当局逮捕，美国正请求将其引渡。
The complaint charges him with one count of wire fraud, 10 counts of commodities fraud and commodities manipulation and one count of “spoofing”, a practice of bidding or offering with the intent to cancel the bid or offe领域r before execution.
The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission (CFTC) also announced the unsealing of a parallel civil enforcement action against Mr. Sarao and his firm Nav Sarao Futures Limited.
萨拉奥先生于2015年2月在伊利诺伊州北区联邦刑事起诉书中被指控。
The CFTC complaint charges him with unlawfully manipulating, attempting to manipulate, and spoofing with regard to the E-mini S&P 500 near month futures contract.
The E-mini S&P 500 is a stock market index futures contract based on the Standard & Poor’s 500 Index and is one of the most popular and liquid equity index futures contracts in the world. The contract is traded only at the Chicago Mercantile Exchange (CME).
起诉书指控他犯有一项电信欺诈罪、十项商品欺诈和商品操纵罪以及一项“幌骗”罪，幌骗是指在执行前有意取消投标或报价的行为。
According to allegations in the criminal complaint, Mr. Sarao allegedly used an automated trading programme to manipulate the market for E-Mini S&P 500 futures contracts on the CME.
From April 2010 to present, he and his firm have profited over $40 million in total from the E-mini S&P trading.
美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）还宣布对萨拉奥先生及其公司Nav Sarao Futures Limited提起平行民事诉讼。
Mr. Sarao’s alleged manipulation contributed to a major drop in the U.S. stock market on May 6, 2010, that came to be known as the “Flash Crash”. On that date, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell by approximately 600 points in a five-minute span, following a drop in the price of E-Minis.
According to the complaint, Mr. Sarao allegedly employed a “dynamic layering” scheme to affect the price of E-Minis.
CFTC的起诉书指控他在E-mini标普500近月期货合约方面非法操纵、企图操纵和幌骗。
By allegedly placing multiple, simultaneous, large-volume sell orders at different price points — a technique known as layering — Mr. Sarao created the appearance of substantial supply in the market.
As part of the scheme, he allegedly modified these orders frequently so that they remained close to the market price, and typically cancelled the orders without executing them. When prices fell as a result of this activity, Mr. Sarao allegedly sold futures contracts only to buy them back at a lower price.
E-mini标普500是基于标准普尔500指数的股指期货合约，是全球最受欢迎且流动性最强的股指期货合约之一。该合约仅在芝加哥商品交易所（CME）交易。
“Today’s actions make clear that the CFTC, working with its partners on the criminal side, will find and prosecute manipulators of U.S. futures markets wherever they may be,” CFTC Director of Enforcement Aitan Goelman said.
In its ongoing litigation, the CFTC is seeking permanent injunctive relief, disgorgement, civil monetary penalties, trading suspensions or bans, and payment of costs and fees.
根据刑事起诉书中的指控，萨拉奥先生涉嫌使用自动交易程序操纵CME的E-mini标普500期货合约市场。
U.S. District Judge Andrea Wood has issued an order freezing and preserving assets under Mr. Sarao and his firm’s control. The court has scheduled a hearing for May 1, 2015, on the CFTC’s motion for a preliminary injunction.

Document 4448: AI-driven Russian disinformation campaign targets German elections
*This article is part of our special report [The dark side of AI innovation is supercharging disinformation and damaging democracy](https://www.euractiv.com/section/tech/special_report/the-dark-side-of-ai-innovation-is-supercharging-disinformation-and-damaging-democracy/).*
*本文是我们特别报道《AI创新的阴暗面正在助长虚假信息并破坏民主》的一部分。*
A Russian influence operation known as "Storm-1516" has set up over 100 websites using artificial intelligence (AI) to spread disinformation and meddle in Germany's upcoming elections.
The network was identified by a joint investigation of [Correctiv](https://correctiv.org/en/fact-checking-en/2025/01/24/disinformation-operation-russian-meddling-in-german-election-campaign-exposed/) and [NewsGuard](https://www.newsguardrealitycheck.com/p/russian-propagandist-turns-his-sights), which found that the campaign has fabricated false claims about German politicians, including deepfake videos and misleading reports, to manipulate public perception.
一个名为“Storm-1516”的俄罗斯影响力行动已利用人工智能（AI）建立了100多个网站，旨在传播虚假信息并干预德国即将举行的选举。
The network mimics real German news outlets and promotes nationalist and Eurosceptic narratives, particularly supporting the Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) party while targeting mainstream politicians.
Examples include allegations of sexual misconduct against Green Party candidate Robert Habeck and Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock, as well as fabricated reports about German military mobilisation and plans to import 1.9 million Kenyan workers.
该网络由Correctiv和NewsGuard的联合调查揭露，调查发现该行动编造了关于德国政客的虚假指控，包括深度伪造视频和误导性报道，以操纵公众认知。
Ties to American Kremlin propagandist
The operation is linked to a former US police officer, John Mark Dougan, who allegedly uses AI to generate fake news and is reportedly funded by Russia's military intelligence agency, the GRU.用途
该网络模仿真实的德国新闻媒体，宣扬民族主义和疑欧论叙事，特别支持德国选择党（AfD），同时针对主流政客。
According to a previous NewsGuard [research](https://www.newsguardtech.com/special-reports/john-mark-dougan-russian-disinformation-network/), Dougan, who fled his home in Florida in 2016 to evade criminal charges and now lives in Russia, is linked to scores of fake news sites pushing the Kremlin's propaganda to US audiences.
Articles on these sites amplify narratives of Ukrainian corruption, a weakening Ukrainian military, and a strong Russian economy while also praising figures like AfD leader Alice Weidel and Elon Musk.
相关案例包括针对绿党候选人罗伯特·哈贝克和外交部长安娜莱娜·贝尔伯克的性不端行为指控，以及关于德国军事动员和计划引进190万肯尼亚工人的捏造报道。
The recent campaign has effectively spread falsehoods through a network of pro-Russian influencers, making it more effective than previous disinformation efforts. Many of the websites appear to have been set up in advance, waiting to be activated for maximum impact on the elections.
The tactics used in Germany mirror those seen in the US presidential elections, where "Storm-1516" aimed to influence the outcome in favour of Donald Trump by producing deepfake videos and fabricated stories about figures like Kamala Harris and Tim Waltz.
**与克里姆林宫美国宣传员的关联**
The campaign's reach has been amplified through social media influencers, some of whom may be financially incentivised to spread disinformation.
**Germany on alert**
该行动与一名前美国警官约翰·马克·杜根有关，据称他利用AI生成假新闻，并据报道由俄罗斯军事情报局（GRU）资助。
Germany's domestic intelligence agency has acknowledged the likelihood of foreign influence in the 2025 elections, and investigations suggest that the same network responsible for US-focused disinformation is now operating in Germany.
Despite denials from Dougan, evidence points to Russian state involvement, particularly through the Foundation to Battle Injustice, a group linked to the late Yevgeny Prigozhin's Internet Research Agency.
根据NewsGuard此前的研究，杜根于2016年为逃避刑事指控逃离佛罗里达州的家中，现居俄罗斯，他与数十个向美国受众推送克里姆林宫宣传的假新闻网站有关联。
The campaign's primary goal is to discredit politicians and manipulate public discourse, regardless of whether the false claims are ultimately believed. Even after being debunked, disinformation continues to spread, highlighting the challenge of combating Russian election interference.
[Edited By Brian Maguire | [Euractiv's Advocacy Lab](https://www.euractiv.com/content_providers/euractivs-advocacy-lab/) ]
这些网站上的文章放大了关于乌克兰腐败、乌克兰军方软弱以及俄罗斯经济强劲的叙事，同时也赞扬了像德国选择党领导人爱丽丝·魏德尔和埃隆·马斯克这样的人物。
Document 4453: The Kremlin wants to influence German elections through disinformation
On the 16th of December 2024, the German Bundestag [voted a motion of no confidence against](https://360stepeni.mk/germanskiot-bundestag-mu-izglasa-nedoverba-na-kantselarot-sholts/) German Chancellor Olaf Scholz. Earlier, he had submitted a request for a vote of confidence in the government to Parliament.
2024年12月16日，德国联邦议院投票通过对德国总理奥拉夫·朔尔茨的不信任动议。此前，他曾向议会提交政府信任投票请求。
Scholz received the support of 207 out of 733 deputies in the Bundestag, while 394 deputies voted against him and 116 abstained. A total of 367 votes were needed for his government to survive.
German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier dissolved the Bundestag and called for early parliamentary elections on the 23rd of February 2025. In announcing the decision, he [emphasized](https://telma.com.mk/2024/12/27/shtajnmaer-go-raspushti-bundestagot-germanija-na-izbori-na-23-fevruari/) the need for a functioning government during challenging times.
朔尔茨在联邦议院733名议员中获得了207人的支持，394名议员投票反对他，116人弃权。他的政府若要存活，共需要367票。
#### Russia "bombards" the German electorate with disinformation
As Germany prepares for elections, pro-Kremlin disinformation narrators are using various tactics to try to disrupt the democratic processes in this European country and influence public opinion.
德国总统弗兰克-瓦尔特·施泰因迈尔解散了联邦议院，并宣布于2025年2月23日举行提前议会选举。在宣布这一决定时，他强调了在充满挑战的时期拥有一个运作良好的政府的必要性。
Information amplification networks tied to the pro-Kremlin foreign information manipulation and interference (FIMI) ecosystem [have targeted](https://btw2025.cemas.io/artikel/update-doppelgaenger) Chancellor Olaf Scholz, the Greens party and the CDU/CSU with narratives blaming them for economic woes and portraying them as unreliable, [Euvsdisinfo](https://mailchi.mp/euvsdisinfo/dr358-6228452?e=18ec3011c4) writes in its analysis.
At the same time, the German edition of Russia's leading propaganda outlet, Russia Today (RT), re-established its presence on the social network X, despite being under [international sanctions.](https://www.consilium.europa.eu/en/press/press-releases/2022/03/02/eu-imposes-sanctions-on-state-owned-outlets-rtrussia-today-and-sputnik-s-broadcasting-in-the-eu/)
#### 俄罗斯用虚假信息“轰炸”德国选民
These coordinated efforts are not isolated incidents, but part of a broader pro-Kremlin strategy to interfere in democratic processes in Europe, [which is not happening for the first time.](https://vistinomer.mk/ruskoto-vlijanie-frli-senka-vrz-izborite-vo-romanija-gruzija-i-moldavija/)
One of the main disinformation narratives that was aimed toward the Scholz government, and was also noticed in Macedonia, was the claim that the current German government plans to legalize pedophilia Originating from the Prigozhin-linked [Russian Foundation to Battle Injustice (R-FBI)](https://edition.cnn.com/2024/10/30/europe/russian-disinformation-harris-walz-us-election-intl/index.html), this absurd claim was amplified through a network of Russian-aligned websites, including inauthentic news outlets and social media accounts, reaching hundreds of thousands of users across platforms such as Threads, Telegram, and X, writes [Euvsdisinfo.](https://mailchi.mp/euvsdisinfo/dr358-6228452?e=18ec3011c4)
随着德国准备大选，亲克里姆林宫的虚假信息传播者正利用各种策略，试图干扰这个欧洲国家的民主进程并影响舆论。
[Truthmeter.mk](https://vistinomer.mk/laga-e-deka-germanija-zapochnala-legaliziranje-na-pedofilijata/) also noticed these disinformation narratives across the social network Facebook.
In another case, typosquatted domains, impersonating reputable outlets such as Der Spiegel, disseminated fabricated articles criticising mainstream German political parties. Manipulative fabrications such as '[Green energy strangles German companies](https://archive.ph/KTxb7)' and '[Merz masks militarism with populism](https://archive.ph/kxdYo)' were amplified by inauthentic accounts, garnering tens of thousands of views, writes [Euvsdisinfo.](https://mailchi.mp/euvsdisinfo/dr358-6228452?e=18ec3011c4)
据Euvsdisinfo分析，与亲克里姆林宫的外国信息操纵与干扰（FIMI）生态系统相关的信息放大网络将矛头对准了朔尔茨总理、绿党和基民盟/基社盟，通过叙事指责他们是经济困境的罪魁祸首，并将他们描绘成不可靠的形象。
Additionally, a false claim that [Germany plans to bring 1.9 million Kenyan workers](https://archive.ph/qyrfY) into the country was circulated widely, with the disinformation narrative crafted to exploit fears of migration to stir division and erode trust in the current government. The story was circulated on a number of websites, Telegram channels, and X accounts tied to the pro-Kremlin ecosystem.
By exploiting fears and other societal vulnerabilities, creating false narratives, and employing advanced amplification techniques, the Kremlin seeks to manipulate and polarize electorates, shape the political environment, and weaken European unity.
与此同时，尽管受到国际制裁，俄罗斯主要宣传机构“今日俄罗斯”（RT）的德语版还是在社交网络X上重新建立了存在。
#### Correctiv: Russian disinformation campaign---100 fake news pages sprouted ahead of German elections
According to [Correctiv's](https://correctiv.org/faktencheck/russische-desinformation/2025/01/23/angriff-aus-russland-auf-bundestagswahl-deepfake-ki/) research, the Russian disinformation campaign created about 100 fake news pages before the German federal elections, and their sole purpose is to influence the election campaign. In a few cases they have already been used to attack politicians.
这些协同努力并非孤立事件，而是亲克里姆林宫干预欧洲民主进程的更广泛战略的一部分，这已不是第一次发生。
> Robert Habeck abused a young woman a few years ago. Annalen Baerbock meets a gigolo on her trips to Africa. The German army mobilizes 500,000 men for a military mission in Eastern Europe. The chairman of the Defense Committee, Marcus Faber, is a Russian agent. A migration agreement with Kenya is bringing 1.9 million Kenyans to Germany, are *only part of the disinformation narratives that [Correctiv](https://correctiv.org/faktencheck/russische-desinformation/2025/01/23/angriff-aus-russland-auf-bundestagswahl-deepfake-ki/) has noted.*
Some of this fake news spread to Macedonia.
针对朔尔茨政府的主要虚假信息叙事之一（在北马其顿也被注意到）是声称现任德国政府计划将恋童癖合法化。据Euvsdisinfo撰文指出，这一荒谬说法源自与普里戈任有关联的“俄罗斯反不公正基金会”（R-FBI），并通过一个与俄罗斯结盟的网站网络进行放大，其中包括虚假新闻媒体和社交媒体账户，在Threads、Telegram和X等平台上触达了数十万用户。
> BREAKING NEWS
>
Truthmeter.mk也在社交网络Facebook上注意到了这些虚假信息叙事。
> Germany is preparing for World War III.
>
在另一个案例中，冒充《明镜周刊》等知名媒体机构的仿冒域名传播了批评德国主流政党的捏造文章。据Euvsdisinfo撰文指出，诸如“绿色能源扼杀德国公司”和“默茨用民粹主义掩盖军国主义”等操纵性捏造内容被虚假账户放大，获得了数万次浏览。
> Germany has begun planning for the deployment of 800,000 NATO troops in Ukraine.
>
此外，关于“德国计划引入190万肯尼亚工人”的虚假说法被广泛传播，该虚假信息叙事旨在利用对移民的恐惧制造分裂，并削弱对现任政府的信任。该故事在与亲克里姆林宫生态系统相关的多个网站、Telegram频道和X账户上流传。
> A 1,000-page military scenario plan has been prepared under the name "Operation Deutschland."
>
通过利用恐惧和其他社会脆弱性、制造虚假叙事以及采用先进的放大技术，克里姆林宫试图操纵和极化选民，塑造政治环境，并削弱欧洲的团结。
> -New York Post
>
#### Correctiv：俄罗斯虚假信息运动——德国大选前涌现100个假新闻页面
> Such news was posted on the social network X, says [a Facebook post.](https://www.facebook.com/CuvariNaMakedonija/posts/pfbid0TDAMqe7L5xAAmzDaA4q2AAVfzMsC4ZdBUFb1yC8ZXyiseq1xZDNcdHKFeRPuEN62l)
![](https://vistinomer.mk/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/52e6c5a2-c94f-4e8a-830e-599bbc56ab2b.jpg)

All of these claims have one thing in common: they are disinformation, use artificial intelligence and deepfakes, and appear on fake news sites. According to Corrective's research, they are part of the new Russian influence operation nicknamed "Bura-1516," which has been interfering in the election campaign ahead of the federal elections for three months.

The trail leads to a former U.S. policeman, the former Russian troll factory the Internet Research Agency (IRA) and the spy agency GRU. The government put the alleged Russian perpetrators on a sanctions list for interfering in the U.S. election campaign.
#### The Kremlin is trying to strengthen AfD
其中一些假新闻传播到了北马其顿。
A Russian disinformation campaign is seeking to boost the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD), undermine mainstream German parties and sow worries about the economy ahead of the country's Feb. 23 election, German think-tank CeMAS has found, [Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-disinformation-targets-german-election-campaign-says-think-tank-2025-01-20/) reports.
CeMAS said it had tracked down hundreds of German-language posts on the social network site X over the past month, exhibiting what it said showed typical patterns of[ Russia's Doppelganger disinformation campaign](https://euvsdisinfo.eu/doppelganger-strikes-back-unveiling-fimi-activities-targeting-european-parliament-elections/) against the West that German, U.S. and French authorities have previously denounced.

In recent weeks, the German posts on X have blamed the Greens party for Germany's economic woes, lambasted Chancellor Olaf Scholz for his support of Ukraine, cast the conservatives as untrustworthy, but spoken in favor of the AfD, CeMAS [noted](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/russian-disinformation-targets-german-election-campaign-says-think-tank).

The report comes a month ahead of the election which Germany's main opposition conservatives are expected to win. However, the strength of the AfD, polling in second place, could make the arithmetic of forming a coalition difficult.

The latest INSA poll [put](https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/russian-disinformation-targets-german-election-campaign-says-think-tank) the conservatives on 29% and the AfD on 21%---twice what it achieved in the 2021 election. Document 4457: Disinformation wave on rise in Germany ahead of elections
Two weeks before the federal election in Germany, the spread of fake news and misinformation, often masterminded by Russia, has intensified, including through the so-called "alternative" media.
据乌克兰国家通讯社报道，德国联邦选举前两周，虚假新闻和错误信息的传播愈演愈烈，这些活动往往由俄罗斯策划，并通过所谓的“替代”媒体进行。
That's according to a government report seen by [POLITICO](https://www.politico.eu/article/germany-election-flood-social-media-x-russia-bots-kremlin-operation-false-news/), Ukrinform wrote.
Russian bots have driven a dramatic surge of disinformation on the social media platform X, the report reads, adding that at the center of the effort to influence German voters is Doppelgänger, a Kremlin-backed operation, according to the German Office of Foreign Affairs.生命周期 The campaign uses fake news sites, sleeper accounts, and AI-generated content to spread false narratives and erode trust in Western institutions.
这一消息源自一份被《政客》杂志看到的政府报告。
Intelligence agencies across the EU and U.S. have previously tracked Doppelgänger's "highly coordinated tactics", which have sought to undermine support for Ukraine in its war against Russia and amplify Kremlin-friendly messaging.
German officials identified more than 100 pseudo-news websites quietly accumulating content for months, according to officials.
报告指出，俄罗斯机器人在社交媒体平台X上推动了虚假信息的急剧增加。据德国外交部称，试图影响德国选民的核心力量是“分身”（Doppelgänger）行动，这是一个由克里姆林宫支持的项目。该行动利用虚假新闻网站、休眠账户和人工智能生成的内容来传播虚假叙事，并削弱公众对西方机构的信任。
"These platforms are structured similarly, filled with generic, often AI-generated articles," one official said. "At a chosen moment, a fabricated story is inserted and then rapidly spread via social media and influencers. We must assume these sites were prepared to be activated in the run-up to the Bundestag election."
These sleeper websites mimic legitimate media outlets and remain inactive until a politically sensitive moment --- such as an election --- when they begin publishing false stories that spread rapidly through coordinated social media networks.
欧盟和美国的情报机构此前已追踪到“分身”行动的“高度协同战术”，这些战术旨在破坏对乌克兰抗击俄罗斯的支持，并放大亲克里姆林宫的信息。
In recent years, European authorities have blamed Moscow for interference in a series of elections. Czech and Belgian authorities busted a major influence network they said was spreading pro-Kremlin propaganda in the runup to last year's European Parliament vote, and in December Romania's presidential elections were canceled after security services warned Russia was mounting "aggressive" hybrid attacks.
The issue is particularly sensitive in the German election, where the Russia-friendly, Elon Musk-backed far-right party Alternative for Germany (AfD) is running second in opinion polls.
据官员透露，德国官员已确认了100多个伪新闻网站，这些网站数月来一直在悄悄积累内容。
Doppelgänger-linked websites have previously cloned outlets like Der Spiegel, altering domain names just slightly to deceive unsuspecting readers.
The clearest sign of escalation is on Musk's X platform, formerly Twitter.
“这些平台结构相似，充斥着通用的、通常是AI生成的文章，”一位官员说。“在选定的时刻，一篇捏造的故事会被植入，然后通过社交媒体和网红迅速传播。我们必须假设，这些网站是为了在德国联邦议院选举前夕被激活而准备的。”
The report, reviewed by POLITICO, shows a sharp increase in posts from ghost accounts, with activity spiking beyond 3,000 posts in a single day in late January. For much of November and December, activity remained relatively low, rarely exceeding 50 posts a day. But in early January, coordinated disinformation posts began appearing at a much higher frequency.
This "overload" technique --- flooding social media with rapid waves of posts to manufacture the illusion of viral traction --- is characteristic of Russian disinformation campaigns.
这些休眠网站模仿合法媒体机构，在政治敏感时刻（如选举）之前保持不活跃状态，一旦时机成熟，便开始发布虚假故事，并通过协同的社交媒体网络迅速传播。
The posts' content also follows a clear pattern. Many target Germany's support for Ukraine, claiming Berlin is prioritizing Kyiv over its own citizens. One example, documented in the report, describes a fabricated corruption scandal involving Economy Minister Robert Habeck and an unnamed "Ukrainian Culture Minister."
Meanwhile, Berlin is stepping up its counter-disinformation efforts, sharing intelligence with international partners, and considering sanctions and public attribution of the networks behind the campaign.
近年来，欧洲当局多次指责莫斯科干预一系列选举。捷克和比利时当局捣毁了一个大型影响力网络，据称该网络在去年欧洲议会选举前夕传播亲克里姆林宫的宣传；去年12月，罗马尼亚总统选举在安全部门警告俄罗斯正在发动“侵略性”混合攻击后被取消。
"We are working on a 'cultural shift' within the Foreign Ministry," the official told POLITICO, referring to growing awareness of cyberthreats. "Ambassadors are becoming more vocal in their host countries. This ensures that when disinformation spreads, they have the credibility and networks to set the record straight."
